final: WITH groups AS (SELECT sp.zoneref AS workflow_site_code, si.insurstat AS insurance_status, AVG(sp.remaingb) AS avg_remaining_storage_gb, AVG(sp.proccpu) - AVG(sp.procgpu) AS avg_cpu_minus_gpu FROM scanprocessing AS sp JOIN sites AS si ON sp.zoneref COLLATE BINARY = si.zoneregistry COLLATE BINARY GROUP BY sp.zoneref, si.insurstat), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_remaining_storage_gb) AS overall_avg_remaining_storage_gb FROM groups) SELECT g.workflow_site_code, g.insurance_status, g.avg_remaining_storage_gb, g.avg_cpu_minus_gpu, g.avg_remaining_storage_gb / o.overall_avg_remaining_storage_gb AS storage_ratio FROM groups AS g CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE o.overall_avg_remaining_storage_gb IS NOT NULL ORDER BY storage_ratio DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10
